This project is using Xcode’s generated Info.plist, so you should configure it in the target settings rather than creating a plist by hand: SwiftTag.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj (line 523) and SwiftTag.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj (line 577). The existing asset catalog app icon is separate and won’t become a document icon by itself: AppIcon.appiconset. Do this in Xcode: Create a document icon file like FlacDocument.icns. Drag that .icns into the SwiftTag target and make sure target membership is checked. Open the SwiftTag target, then Info, then add a Document Type. Set: Name: FLAC Audio Types: flac Role: Editor if SwiftTag owns editing, otherwise Viewer Handler Rank: Owner or Alternate Icon File: FlacDocument.icns Build, reinstall the app, then relaunch Finder if the icon cache is stubborn. One project-specific caution: SwiftTag does not currently appear to handle Finder-opened files yet, so registering .flac as a document type is only half the job if you want double-click/open-in-Finder to work. I have added icons and I have added the FLAC Audio Document Type. I am not sure where to enter "Types: flac" is this a "LSItemContentType" and what about NSExportableTypes? Yes: the document type’s Types field corresponds to LSItemContentTypes, and that field should contain a UTI, not the bare file extension. So: LSItemContentTypes: use something like org.xiph.flac or another UTI you declare for FLAC File extension flac: this belongs in the UTI declaration’s tag spec, not directly in LSItemContentTypes A good mental model is: Define or import a UTI for FLAC Map that UTI to .flac Point your document type at that UTI If Xcode is showing the raw plist structure, it looks like this conceptually: ```xml <key>UTImportedTypeDeclarations</key> <array> <dict> <key>UTTypeIdentifier</key> <string>org.xiph.flac</string> <key>UTTypeConformsTo</key> <array> <string>public.audio</string> <string>public.data</string> </array> <key>UTTypeTagSpecification</key> <dict> <key>public.filename-extension</key> <array> <string>flac</string> </array> <key>public.mime-type</key> <string>audio/flac</string> </dict> </dict> </array> <key>CFBundleDocumentTypes</key> <array> <dict> <key>CFBundleTypeName</key> <s
